title: V Stitch line at PE-DESIGN's defaults
description: An open line (10,20)-(50,20)-(50,40) mm sewn as V Stitch with no attribute set, so OpenStitch's defaults are compared with PE-DESIGN 11.50's: stitch count, typical and longest stitch, and the bounds (which show the width, the side, the corner and the ends).

evidence.note: docs/COMPATIBILITY_AUDIT.md, Uncalibrated numeric defaults (line pitch, line widths)
line sew types and their attributes

references.make: On a 100 x 100 mm Design Page (grid 1 mm, Snap to Grid) draw an open straight line by clicking (10, 20), (50, 20) and double-clicking (50, 40) mm. Region Not Sewn. Line sew type V Stitch, colour 800 RED, every other line attribute left at the value PE-DESIGN shows for that type on a fresh design. Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system, every line attribute PE-DESIGN shows for the type with its value, and the status-bar size and stitch count in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN reference: needle points on the same line

PE-DESIGN reference: mean of the arms and the line between Vs. Not the median: the V's arms (2.69 mm) and its baseline (1.5 mm) are almost equally many, so PE-DESIGN's longer start lock (three 0.3 mm steps) alone tips the median from one to the other; stitches under 1 mm (the locks) are left out
PE-DESIGN reference: how far the stitches reach above the 40 mm leg (width, side)
PE-DESIGN reference: where the 20 mm leg ends (ends, lock stitches)
PE-DESIGN reference: how far the stitches reach beside the 20 mm leg (width, corner)
PE-DESIGN reference: where the 40 mm leg starts (ends, lock stitches)
